context:
Goal: you see context fill in the Claude app.
Problem (goal): token-weather does load in cloud sessions, but it draws in the above-prompt band, which the mod API says only the terminal draws.
Based on (measured): mods load in a cloud session from its second start on; plugins install about 3 minutes after the first start (plugin cache written 10:33 UTC, session started 10:29 UTC; at 11:47 CST all 7 were installed and ponytail's start hook ran). The earlier "no mod loads in cloud" was wrong: that check ran before the install.
Based on (read): the mod API raises the above-prompt band on the terminal only, and raises a pane on every surface, the phone and desktop apps too. Whether the app draws a mod's pane for a cloud session is unmeasured.
Departs from: main (a terminal-only band) — adds a reading the app can draw.

lastAnswer.note: look at the mod and the outocme more hollistically before returning to me

options.gain: One mod keeps the reading, and the app may show it.
options.how: token-weather also opens a one-line pane, which every surface draws, and keeps the band in the terminal. Then you check once in the app whether it shows.
options.label: Show the reading in a small pane too
options.lose: Whether the app draws it for a cloud session is unknown until your check; a pane takes screen space.

options.how: A hook in your settings prints the context fill as one message after each turn. First you check whether a hook's message shows in the app.
options.label: A Stop hook prints one context line
options.lose: One extra line after every turn, and a second home for the reading.

options.how: The band stays in the terminal only.
options.label: Drop token-weather in cloud
options.lose: No context reading in the app.

ref: step mods-relevance-review (your 105 a: fix both mods); mod token-weather
reply: No build. Sessions already act on their own context: they write handoffs at checkpoints, standing sessions rotate before the limit, and the cloud session record carries context fill for the coordinator. token-weather stays as the terminal bar. If you want a gauge in the app anyway, say so and it comes back as a question.
title: How should you see context fill in the Claude app?
why: It keeps one home for the reading, and the mod API says panes reach the apps.
